thought.text: I'll add a dev `backend-wms` service using the already-built backend dev image.

action.command:
cd /workspace/deployment && python3 - <<'PY' 2>/dev/null || echo "no python, doing sed"
PY
cp docker-compose.dev.yml /tmp/dev.pre_wms.yml
# Insert backend-wms service before the nginx block
awk '
/^  nginx:/ && !done {
  print "  backend-wms:"
  print "    image: qonnectra/backend:dev"
  print "    container_name: qonnectra_backend_wms_dev"
  print "    restart: unless-stopped"
  print "    command: gunicorn --bind 0.0.0.0:8000 --workers 2 --timeout 60 core.wsgi:application"
  print "    expose:"
  print "      - \"8000\""
  print "    volumes:"
  print "      - static_volume:/app/static"
  print "      - media_volume:/app/media"
  print "    environment:"
  print "      - DEBUG=${DEBUG:-True}"
  print "      - DJANGO_SECRET_KEY=${DJANGO_SECRET_KEY}"
  print "      - DJANGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS=${DJANGO_ALLOWED_HOSTS:-api.localhost,localhost,127.0.0.1}"
  print "      - USE_COOKIE_DOMAIN_MIDDLEWARE=${USE_COOKIE_DOMAIN_MIDDLEWARE:-True}"
  print "      - COOKIE_DOMAIN=${COOKIE_DOMAIN:-.localhost}"
  print "      - DB_NAME=${DB_NAME}"
  print "      - DB_USER=${DB_USER}"
  print "      - DB_PASSWORD=${DB_PASSWORD}"
  print "      - DB_HOST=db"
  print "      - DB_PORT=5432"
  print "      - DEFAULT_SRID=${DEFAULT_SRID:-25832}"
  print "      - CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=${CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS:-https://app.localhost}"
  print "      - CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS=${CSRF_TRUSTED_ORIGINS:-https://api.localhost,https://app.localhost}"
  print "      - FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEY=${FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEY}"
  print "      - QGIS_DOMAIN=${QGIS_DOMAIN:-qgis.localhost}"
  print "    depends_on:"
  print "      db:"
  print "        condition: service_healthy"
  print "    networks:"
  print "      - qonnectra_network"
  print ""
  done=1
}
{ print }
' /tmp/dev.pre_wms.yml > docker-compose.dev.yml
docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml config --quiet && echo "CONFIG OK"; grep -n "backend-wms:" docker-compose.dev.yml
